ambiguous.draw: draw + weapon = ready weapon (combat); draw a map/card = other; draw a bow = ranged
ambiguous.cut: cut at/down a foe = melee; cut rope/bread = manipulate/work
ambiguous.clear: clear a nest/room of foes = combat; clear a table = work
ambiguous.charge: charge at a foe = melee; charge a price = speak/sell
ambiguous.hit: hit a foe = melee; hit the road = move

ambiguous.throw: throw a weapon at a foe = ranged; throw an item to someone = transfer/gift; throw in (offer) = trade
ambiguous.fire: fire at = ranged; fire a worker = speak

ambiguous.shove: shove a foe = unarmed; shove a door/crate = manipulate (athletics)
ambiguous.pin: pin a foe = unarmed; pin a note = manipulate

ambiguous.plan: plan a fight = tactics; plan a trip = freeform, no roll
ambiguous.retreat: retreat in a fight = tactics/dodge; leave a room = move

ambiguous.duck: duck a blow = dodge; duck into a shop = move
ambiguous.roll: roll aside = dodge; roll dice/barrel = other/manipulate

ambiguous.hide: hide oneself = stealth; hide an item = manipulate (+stealth vs search)
ambiguous.slip: slip past/away = stealth; slip an item into a pocket = sleight_of_hand; slip someone a coin openly = gift
ambiguous.shadow: shadow a person = stealth (follow unseen); follow tracks = tracking
ambiguous.stalk: stalk a person = stealth; stalk game = tracking/survival (hunt)
ambiguous.follow: follow openly = move; follow unseen = stealth; follow a trail = tracking

ambiguous.pick: pick a lock = lockpicking; pick a pocket = sleight_of_hand; pick up = transfer; pick flowers = survival
ambiguous.force: force a lock = lockpicking/STR; force someone = intimidation
ambiguous.open: open an unlocked door = manipulate, no roll; locked = lockpicking

ambiguous.scale: scale + the/a/up wall = climbing; a scale (weighing) = not a verb
ambiguous.scramble: scramble up rocks = climbing; scramble away = dodge/move

ambiguous.ask: plain ask = speak, no roll; ask for a favour/discount the NPC resists = persuasion
ambiguous.offer: offer a deal = trade (persuasion only if haggling); offer a gift = transfer gift
ambiguous.negotiate: price talk = persuasion; plain buy at list price = buy, no roll
ambiguous.haggle: haggle/bargain = persuasion check; appraisal (if known) sets the anchor price and gives a bonus

ambiguous.pretend: pretend to an NPC = deception; pretend in narration = no roll
ambiguous.cheat: cheat by lying = deception; by hand (cards, dice) = sleight_of_hand
ambiguous.forge: forge papers = deception; forge a blade = crafting

ambiguous.demand: firm request = speak; demand with threat = intimidation
ambiguous.glare: glare as flavour = speak tone; glare to force compliance = intimidation

ambiguous.look: look around = observe, no roll (2026-10-07); look for something hidden = insight
ambiguous.read: read a person = insight; read a sign/book = observe (or history/arcana)
ambiguous.search: search a room = perception (v2); read motives = insight

ambiguous.greet: plain greeting = speak, no roll; greeting a noble where form matters = etiquette
ambiguous.bow: bow as gesture = speak; bow (weapon) = ranged noun

ambiguous.hunt: hunt = find game (tracking) + catch (survival/ranged); presence alone yields nothing
ambiguous.gather: gather herbs/wood = survival; medicinal herb use = medicine
ambiguous.trap: set a trap = survival; trap a foe = tactics
ambiguous.catch: catch game/fish = survival; catch a thrown item = dodge/DEX, transfer pickup

ambiguous.follow: follow a trail = tracking; follow a person openly = move
ambiguous.scout: scout ahead = tracking/insight; scout unseen = stealth

ambiguous.recognize: recognize a crest/ruin = history; recognize a rune = arcana; recognize a face = insight
ambiguous.remember: player memory recap = no roll; lore = history

ambiguous.ward: magic ward = arcana; guard a door = wait

ambiguous.look: look around = observe, no roll; look for something hidden = perception

ambiguous.notice: passive notice = GM-side perception vs DC; active = rolled

ambiguous.pick: pick a pocket = sleight_of_hand; pick a lock = lockpicking
ambiguous.slip: slip something into a pocket/drink unseen = sleight_of_hand; slip past = stealth
ambiguous.steal: from a person or under watch = sleight_of_hand; unwatched item = take, no roll

ambiguous.swing: swing a weapon = melee; swing from a rope/chandelier = acrobatics
ambiguous.roll: roll aside from a blow = dodge; tumble/roll on landing = acrobatics
ambiguous.jump: small hop = move, no roll; gap/ledge = acrobatics
ambiguous.escape: wriggle out of bonds = acrobatics (escape artist folded)

phrases: tell a story to the crowd

ambiguous.play: play an instrument/role = performance; play cards = no roll (or sleight/deception)
ambiguous.tell: tell a tale to entertain = performance; tell someone a fact = speak
ambiguous.act: act a part on stage = performance; act a part to fool someone = deception

ambiguous.treat: treat a wound = medicine; treat someone to a drink = buy/gift
ambiguous.dress: dress a wound = medicine; get dressed = no roll
ambiguous.tend: tend the wounded = medicine; tend a fire = no roll

ambiguous.weigh: weigh coins/goods for value = appraisal; weigh options = no roll
ambiguous.identify: identify a magic item = arcana; identify a forgery/quality/value = appraisal
ambiguous.price: ask the listed price = speak, no roll; work out true value/scarcity = appraisal

ambiguous.brew: brew a potion/poison = alchemy; brew ale = cooking
ambiguous.mix: mix reagents = alchemy; mix drinks = no roll
ambiguous.identify: identify a potion = alchemy; magic item = arcana

ambiguous.forge: forge a blade = smithing; forge papers = deception
ambiguous.hammer: hammer metal = smithing; hammer a nail = carpentry

ambiguous.build: build with wood = carpentry; build a fire = survival
ambiguous.carve: carve wood = carpentry; carve meat = cooking, no roll

ambiguous.cure: cure a hide = leatherworking; cure a wound = medicine

ambiguous.cook: a simple meal = no roll; a feast or preserving = cooking roll

ambiguous.take: take a sip/bite = body; take a job = work; take from NPC without consent = steal; from ground = pickup
ambiguous.lift: lift a crate = work; lift a purse = steal
ambiguous.leave: leave a room = move; leave an item = drop
ambiguous.keep: keep an item = no transfer (refuse to give); keep an eye on = perception; keep voice low = private speech
ambiguous.share: share food/drink = gift; share news = speak

thoroughly.note: search: much more time, best odds

quietly.note: movement/manipulate -> stealth mode; with ask/say/tell/whisper -> private speech (audience=target), no modifier

silently.note: stealth mode; with speech -> says nothing / gesture

loudly.note: stealth -2 / draws attention; speech: everyone hears

forcefully.note: STR actions +1; social: intimidation tone, persuasion -1

politely.note: tone hint; etiquette/persuasion +1 if NPC values manners

recklessly.note: fast, very risky; GM may add consequence
